end.summary:
Practised identifying what common animals eat and sorting plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and both.
Built food chains using arrows to show who eats what.
Read three food chains correctly, including grass → deer → lion and algae → larvae → fish.
Explained that arrows point toward the animal receiving the food.
end.parentNote: Manav practised naming animal foods and building food chains with arrows. They used the food-chain method successfully in three examples and explained why the arrows point from food to eater. They were initially unsure about the arrow direction, then corrected it during the lesson. At home, ask them to make one food chain from a plant, an insect, and a bird.
